info.title: Brainitive App API
info.description:
The JSON API of the first-party **Brainitive Desktop** and **Brainitive Mobile** apps. Every
Brainitive server (Brainitive Cloud or self-hosted) serves it under `/api/v1`.

It is separate from the MCP server, the CLI and the browser extension: own tokens, own guard, own
rate limits. Conventions (full text in `docs/ai/API.md` of the repository):

- **Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer bra_...` - a 15-minute access token from the native sign-in
  (`/app/authorize` in the system browser -> `POST /auth/exchange`). Refresh with
  `POST /auth/refresh` (`brr_...`, 60 days, single use; replaying an old one revokes the
  device). Tokens of the MCP / CLI / extension clients get 401 here. The TV app (device-code
  sign-in, `POST /auth/device`) may only call a read-mostly list of endpoints (`docs/ai/API.md`);
  anything else answers 403 `client_not_allowed`.
- **Errors:** always `{"message": "...", "code": "...", "errors"?: {"field": ["..."]}}` - 401
  `unauthenticated`, 403 `forbidden` (or `client_not_allowed`: not for this app), 404 `not_found`,
  409 `conflict`, 422 `validation_failed`,
  429 `rate_limited`. A 404 can also mean "exists, but not for you".
- **Dates:** ISO-8601 UTC.
- **Lists:** cursor pagination `?cursor=&limit=` (default 50, max 100) -> `{data, next_cursor}`;
  `updated_since` for sync.
- **Writes:** `Idempotency-Key` accepted; updates carry `revision` / `updated_at` -> 409 on conflict.

`interval`), `slow_down` (asked too soon: wait 5 s longer from now on), `access_denied` (the user
said no: stop), `expired_token` (start again), `invalid_grant` (unknown or already used code).

post.description:
`{changes: [{request_id, type, target?, base?, data}]}` (≤ 50), applied in order, each on its own: one
result per change in the same order, and one bad change never stops the others. Types and their data
are the web's offline mutations (`list_task.create|update|reorder`, `issue.update|comment|create`,
`capture.create`, `my_day.add|remove`) plus `work.done`. Updates carry `base.fields` (each changed
field as the device saw it): a field someone else changed meanwhile is a `conflict` (409) and is not
written — never overwritten. `request_id` makes a change idempotent (30 days): a retry answers the
stored result (`replayed: true`); the same id with another change → `invalid`. `entity` is the server's
current state as the feed's record of `record_type` (work, task, task_list, capture, my_day, comment).
`target.ref` / `data.work_ref` = the request_id of an earlier create (in this batch or before). Budget:
240 changes a minute per user (`rate_limited`: send it again later).
post.summary: Apply a batch of queued offline changes

icon.description: an emoji (image icons: web only); null removes it

UpdateBookmarkGroupRequest.title: UpdateBookmarkGroupRequest

UpdateCalendarEventRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/calendar/events/{id}`: change the sent fields of an event in one of the user's own writable
calendars (the web calendar's event dialog). Moving it: send `date` (+ `time`, `end_date`, `end_time`) —
without `time` it becomes an all-day event.

date.description: new first day, Y-m-d: replaces all of the event's dates and times

timezone.description: IANA zone of date / time, default the user's

UpdateCalendarEventRequest.title: UpdateCalendarEventRequest

UpdateCalendarFeedRequest.description:
`PUT /api/v1/me/calendar-feed`: turn the private feed on, or replace its options (a missing option takes
its default, as on the web). `options.project_ids` = only these projects (empty = all the user can open).
UpdateCalendarFeedRequest.title: UpdateCalendarFeedRequest

UpdateCaptureRequest.description: `PATCH /api/v1/captures/{id}`: Capture::rules(), but only the sent fields change.
UpdateCaptureRequest.title: UpdateCaptureRequest

UpdateDeviceRequest.description:
PATCH /api/v1/devices/current: the calling app updates what it knows about itself (after an
update, a rename, or once it has a push token). Only the sent fields change; a null push_token
removes it.

push_token.description: APNs device token / FCM registration token; stored encrypted, never returned

UpdateDeviceRequest.title: UpdateDeviceRequest

UpdateFeedbackPostRequest.description: `PATCH /api/v1/feedback-posts/{id}`: the public status of an idea (Planned / Building / Released …) and its note.

note.description: shown on the public post ("Shipping in May"); null clears it

UpdateFeedbackPostRequest.title: UpdateFeedbackPostRequest

UpdateIssueRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/items/{id}`: only the sent fields change (the issue dialog's rules, Support\Boards\Issues).
`updated_at` (the issue's, as last read) makes it a conditional write: 409 when it changed since.

updated_at.description: the issue's updated_at as last read: 409 conflict when it changed since

UpdateIssueRequest.title: UpdateIssueRequest

UpdateLeadRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/leads/{id}`: move a lead to a pipeline column and / or change its contact details and assignee.
Authorized before validation: a lead of a project the user can't open is a 404, project viewers a 403
(LeadFormPolicy::manageLeads).

column_id.description: a column of the lead's form (its pipeline stage)

position.description: place in the column, 0 = top (default: keep it where it lands, the end)

assignee_id.description: a member of the project, or null

UpdateLeadRequest.title: UpdateLeadRequest

UpdateMeRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/me` (BRAI-384): the fields the web Profile page edits, each optional. Same rules
as the web (ProfileUpdateRequest). The email address is web only: a new one must be verified.

timezone.description: all_with_bc: browsers still report old names such as "Asia/Calcutta".

UpdateMeRequest.title: UpdateMeRequest

UpdateNotificationPreferencesRequest.description:
`PUT /api/v1/me/notification-preferences` (BRAI-393): Profile → Notifications. Partial: only the
sent categories and channels change — `{preferences: {"mentions": {"push": false}}}`.
UpdateNotificationPreferencesRequest.title: UpdateNotificationPreferencesRequest

UpdatePageRequest.description:
`PATCH /pages/{uuid}`: only the sent fields change. A doc's text is replaced as a whole, so `markdown` needs
the `revision` the app last read (409 when the page changed since — live editors save every few seconds).

markdown.description: docs only; replaces the whole text

revision.description: the page's `revision` as last read: 409 conflict when it changed since (required with `markdown`)

UpdatePageRequest.title: UpdatePageRequest

UpdatePinsRequest.description:
`PUT /api/v1/me/pins` (BRAI-391): replace one project's sidebar pins (the web's sidebar rules,
SidebarPreferencesController). Pins the user can't open are dropped, not an error.

pins.description: the whole list, in sidebar order; [] unpins everything

pinned_only.description: show only the Pinned group of this project

UpdatePinsRequest.title: UpdatePinsRequest

UpdateSnippetCollectionRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/snippet-collections/{id}`: only the sent fields change. Not a member → 404; not its
creator or a workspace admin → 403 (SnippetPolicy::update).

icon.description: an emoji (the web also takes an uploaded image's URL)

visibility.description: private (members only) | public (anyone with the share link)

UpdateSnippetCollectionRequest.title: UpdateSnippetCollectionRequest

UpdateSnippetRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/snippets/{id}`: only the sent fields change. Not a member → 404; not a workspace
editor / admin → 403 (SnippetPolicy::create, as the web).
UpdateSnippetRequest.title: UpdateSnippetRequest

UpdateTaskRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/task-lists/{id}/items/{item}`: only the sent fields change (`null` clears one).
`status: done` on a repeating task with a due date moves it to its next date and keeps it open.

assignee_id.description: Only people in this workspace who can open the project can be assigned.

notes.description: Markdown; stored as the web editor's HTML; null clears it

UpdateTaskRequest.title: UpdateTaskRequest

UpdateTicketRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/tickets/{id}`: the sent fields change — status (column), assignee, priority, subject.
Moving into a done column can carry the closing message and email the customer, as the web's "Resolve".

column_id.description: a column of the ticket's helpdesk (its status)

resolution_message.description: into a done column: a closing message, saved as a reply to the customer

notify_contact.description: into a done column: email the customer that it's resolved

priority_id.description: a priority of the project (GET /helpdesks/{id} → priorities), or null

updated_at.description: the time of the ticket the app last read (updated_at): 409 when it changed since

UpdateTicketRequest.title: UpdateTicketRequest

UpdateWorkLogRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/work-logs/{id}`: only the sent fields change — the rest is taken from the entry and the
whole form is validated as on the web. Only the user's own entries (404 otherwise).
UpdateWorkLogRequest.title: UpdateWorkLogRequest

url.description: public, no token needed (like issue attachments)

elements.description: Excalidraw elements (type, x, y, width, height, text, …) as the editor saved them

app_state.description: canvas settings: viewBackgroundColor, gridSize, scrollX / scrollY, zoom

files.description: images on the board by file id: {mimeType, dataURL, …}

preview_image_url.description: PNG of the last "Save & exit" on the web; null when there is none

done.description: true: complete it (issue → the board's first done column); false: reopen it

id.description: issue:<id> | task:<id>: use it for PATCH /me/work/{id} and My Day

status.description: issues: the board column; tasks: To do / Done

due_date.description: the user's wall clock: Y-m-d and H:i

source.description: where it lives: a board or a task list

spent_on.description: Y-m-d, the day the work was done

source.description: manual | timer | legacy (logged before the timesheet existed: only date, activity and note change)

locked.description: billed on a finalized report: no edits, no deletes

from.description: the Monday of the first week

members.description: [{id, name, avatar_display, capacity_minutes, work, cells: [{week, capacity_minutes, allocated_minutes, load_percent, state, allocations, …}]}]

role.description: from the membership row when the list loaded it (no query per workspace)

projects.description: the projects this user can open (workspace admins: all), as on the web

billing_url.description: "Plan & billing" on the web; null on self-hosted installs
